_readme: Per-hop worker cost on the Elk Stomp (one Cortex-A7 core), p50 per stage, resampler-fixed build (16/17 Sep 2026). Every corpus carries a 'measured' block (drawn without hatching; the int8 search carries a dotted pattern); 'measured_prefix_build' keeps the first-session values for the record. 'stages' holds fitted coefficients for other corpus sizes (hatched if used). Edit values only from logs; re-run fig1_budget.py.
